figurative_meaning_en: to ruin completely or destroy utterly
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজটা তার দফা শেষ করে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I'll make sure to finish you off completely.
This mistake has ruined him utterly.
note: The idiom implies bringing something or someone to a definitive and often destructive end, rooted in narrative or legal chapter-ending metaphors.
